=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:517-525 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: If the post-create `_list_digest` call fails after the digest entry is created, the helper returns an error and the caller does not send the required first-park CRITICAL alert.
  WHY: The item is already in the digest, so later pruning and scanning treat it as parked and do not retry the lost alert.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:559 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The disabled early-return result from `needs_human_prune` omits the `"items"` key present in its other return paths.
  WHY: A direct caller accessing `result["items"]` on this path gets a `KeyError`; the poller currently guards against reaching it.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:531-536 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When a concurrent-writer check closes the newly created digest, it does not remove the `ai:needs-human` label from the original item.
  WHY: The item remains labeled as parked without an entry in any digest, so the unblock scan skips it as parked indefinitely.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:588-591 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When pruning detects that a concurrent process changed the digest, it gives up without retrying.
  WHY: Stale entries may remain in the digest, causing an item to be incorrectly treated as parked or keeping the digest size artificially high and potentially hitting the entry cap.
- operator_step_issue.py:328-329, 533-539; unblock_scan.py:205, 262-264 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Items beyond the 1,000-item overflow list are not included in the poller’s parked-item set.
  WHY: After the verdict retry window expires, the scan can dispatch the item again and report it as newly parked with another CRITICAL alert; repeated cycles can also increment the dropped count.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: A direct caller accessing `result["items"]` when the kill switch is off gets a `KeyError`; the current poller guards against this path.

  PROBLEM: Once the digest has 200 entries and 1,000 overflow IDs, parking another item records only an incremented dropped count, not its item number.
  WHY: After the verdict marker ages out, the scan dispatches the item again even though it was parked; the next park can send another CRITICAL alert, and repeated cycles increment the dropped count.
- operator_step_issue.py:517-525; unblock_judge.sh:358-361 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After successfully creating a digest containing the item, the helper performs another `_list_digest` call; if that verification call fails, the helper returns an error even though the digest and entry were created, and the caller sends the CRITICAL alert only on success with `newly_parked`.
  WHY: Later pruning and scanning treat the item as parked and do not retry the alert after a transient API failure.

  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
